# IJSSER - International Journal of Social Science & Economic Research

> A peer-reviewed open-access academic journal publishing research in social science and economics with rigorous editorial standards and global indexing.

IJSSER is an international academic journal dedicated to publishing original research in social science and economic fields. The journal maintains high publication ethics standards, offers open-access publishing, and serves researchers globally with indexed content and peer-review processes.

## Key Topics

- Open Access Publishing
- Peer Review
- Social Science Research
- Economics
- Publication Ethics
- Academic Journal
- Paper Submission
- Author Guidelines
- Editorial Board
- Google Scholar Indexing
- DOI
- COPE Standards
- Creative Commons Attribution
- Call for Papers
- International Research
